description: This Java class 'ExecHelper' provides utility methods for executing and managing an external simulator process, capturing its output and error streams, and handling its lifecycle within the application. It includes methods to run, dump output, create error stream echoing, and destroy the process.

classes.name: ExecHelper
classes.description: A utility class providing methods to execute, manage, and log output from an external simulator process.

methods.name: runSimulator
methods.description: Starts the simulator process, logs its size and output, and waits for its completion.

methods.name: dumpProcessOutput
methods.description: Reads and logs the output and error streams from the specified process.

methods.name: readAndPrint
methods.description: Reads lines from a BufferedReader and passes them to a consumer for processing.

methods.name: createErrorStreamEcho
methods.description: Creates a Runnable that reads the error stream from a process and logs its output.

methods.name: destroy
methods.description: Destroys the simulator process if it is running.

methods.name: startSimulator
methods.description: Starts the simulator process in a new thread.
